module: "Measurements" tab of the rally editor: a tool for measuring distances along the road (snaproad). The user creates measurements, clicks points in the 3D view (snapped to the snaproad within 5 m), reorders them, moves them by dragging, and reads the total distance, either following the road ("Follow Route" option) or in a straight line. Measurements are saved automatically in <mission>/measurements.json. The module returns a constructor (class C).
notes: Format of the measurements.json file: { measurements = { ["id"] = {id, name, points = [{x,y,z}], followRoute, color = {r,g,b}, textColor = {r,g,b}} }, nextMeasurementId, updatedAt }.
Distances in meters. A new measurement's color is random (vivid HSV) and the text color is black or white depending on luminance.
Point selection radius: 8 m (pointSelectRadius). Without a snaproad, points are not snapped.
Each modification (creation, deletion, point add/remove/move) calls saveMeasurements(). updateMeasurement (renaming) does not save immediately.
getMeasurementsFilePath() uses rallyEditor.getMissionDir(), whereas the other tabs use getCurrentMissionDir().

C.desc: Tab object returned by the constructor (new(rallyEditor)). Fields: measurements (table id -> measurement {id, name, points (vec3), totalDistance, followRoute, color, textColor}), selectedMeasurementId, selectedPointIndex, nextMeasurementId, snaproad, updatedAt. windowDescription = 'Measurements'.

init.desc: Internal constructor: initializes the measurements and the interaction state (hover, drag).

clearState.desc: Clears the measurements, the selection and the interaction state.

getMeasurementsFilePath.desc: Path of the measurements.json file in the mission folder.

returns.desc: Path, or nil (with a log error) without a mission folder.

serialize.desc: Converts the measurements to a JSON-compatible table (vec3 points become {x,y,z}).

deserialize.desc: Rebuilds the measurements from the JSON data, with default colors (yellow / black), and recomputes nextMeasurementId (largest id + 1).

data.desc: Data read from the file; nothing is done if nil.

saveMeasurements.desc: Updates updatedAt and writes the measurements.json file (automatic save).

returns.desc: false if the file path is unknown.

loadMeasurements.desc: Reads measurements.json if it exists (updatedAt taken from the file date if missing), deserializes then recomputes the distances.

returns.desc: true if the file was loaded.

setPath.desc: Sets the current notebook (the code comment notes that "path" actually refers to the notebook).

setSnaproad.desc: Sets the snaproad used for snapping and distance computation.

selected.desc: Called by the editor when the tab is selected: fetches the snaproad from the pacenotes window, loads measurements.json and emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

unselect.desc: Called when the tab is left: emits onEditorEditModeChanged(nil, nil).

drawDebugEntrypoint.desc: 3D rendering called every frame: draws the snaproad (black) then the measurement points and lines.

drawMeasurementPoints.desc: Draws in 3D the points (spheres), segments, route following and distance labels of each measurement.

createMeasurement.desc: Creates an empty measurement (followRoute = true, random color), selects it and saves.

deleteMeasurement.desc: Deletes a measurement, deselects if needed, recomputes nextMeasurementId and saves.

selectMeasurement.desc: Selects a measurement and clears the point selection.

addPointToMeasurement.desc: Adds a point at the end of the measurement, selects it, recomputes the distance and saves.

removePointFromMeasurement.desc: Removes a point (adjusts the selected index), recomputes the distance and saves.

movePointUp.desc: Swaps the point with the previous one (index - 1), recomputes and saves.

movePointDown.desc: Swaps the point with the next one (index + 1), recomputes and saves.

calculateMeasurementDistance.desc: Computes and stores totalDistance in meters. With followRoute and a snaproad, the distance follows the road between consecutive points; otherwise it is the sum of the direct distances. 0 if there are fewer than 2 points.

findNearestPoint.desc: Searches, across all measurements, for the point closest to a position.

returns.desc: Distance (math.huge if there are no points).

handleMouseInput.desc: Handles the mouse in the 3D view: hover, selection, drag-and-drop and adding points snapped to the snaproad (distance < 5 m).

draw.desc: Draws the imgui interface: creating/deleting measurements, list, options (Follow Route, colors), total distance, point list and Move Up / Move Down / Delete Point buttons.
